headline: Contested Fronts Stir as Base Traffic Shifts
war_summary: The latest ledger finds War 140 still without a recorded victor, with 34 victory towns required. Weathered Expanse remains the busiest front, though its 54 base-event entries over 24 hours are down from 60 in the last edition; four came in the latest two hours. Its nine bases now stand five Colonial, two Warden and two neutral. Nevish Line has quickened from 35 daily entries to 43, including six in the latest two hours; seven of its eight bases are Warden-held and one Colonial. Marban Hollow edged up from 37 to 39 entries, but none came in the latest two hours; its eight bases are split four Warden, three Colonial and one neutral. Kuura Strand rose from 29 to 33 entries, with three recent; its tally is four Colonial and two Warden. Linn Mercy logged five entries in the latest two hours and 11 over the day, with nine Colonial, one Warden and one neutral base. Godcrofts holds at six daily entries, none recent, and all nine bases are Colonial. Activity remains concentrated on these contested ledgers.
